verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Sentry serves an llms.txt at docs.sentry.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and its content is explicitly framed for 'developers and their agents'. The docs also offer agent-directed setup that 'Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and more', so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs as the story asks. missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's depth and contents beyond its header, per-page markdown docs (the .md variant returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Sentry is an application monitoring platform that helps developers and their agents have the context needed
Your agent will set up Sentry in your Python app automatically. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and more.
